lead.en: Mount a complete CAD editor with one function, then control drawings, files, commands and selection through a small typed API.
lead.zh: 一个函数挂载完整 CAD 编辑器，再通过小而清晰的类型化 API 控制图档、文件、命令与选择。

vueCode:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { KJDraw, type KJDrawExposed } from '@kanjieteam/kjdraw/vue'

const editor = ref<KJDrawExposed | null>(null)
</script>

<template>
  <KJDraw ref="editor" document="sample" locale="en" style="height: 720px" />
</template>

options.name: document
options.en: Initial drawing. 'sample' opens the included example; 'blank' and null create an empty drawing.
options.zh: 初始图档。'sample' 打开内置示例；'blank' 与 null 创建空白图档。

options.name: sdk
options.en: Reuse an application SDK so commands, plugins and documents share one registry.
options.zh: 复用应用 SDK，让命令、插件与图档共享同一注册表。

options.name: theme
options.zh: 面板与画布的初始外观。

options.name: readonly
options.en: Keep inspection, navigation and export while disabling editing controls.
options.zh: 保留检查、导航与导出，同时禁用编辑控件。

options.name: title
options.en: Override the drawing title displayed in the workbench header.
options.zh: 覆盖工作台顶部显示的图档标题。

options.name: maxFileBytes
options.en: Maximum input size checked before an opened file is read.
options.zh: 打开文件前检查的最大输入字节数。

options.name: onReady
options.en: Called after the initial drawing and renderer are ready.
options.zh: 初始图档与渲染器就绪后调用。

options.name: onChange
options.en: Receives the document, revision and entity count after a drawing change.
options.zh: 图档变化后接收 document、revision 与 entityCount。

options.name: onSelectionChange
options.en: Receives the active document and selected object IDs.
options.zh: 接收活动图档与已选对象 ID。

options.name: onError
options.en: Receives initialization, file and command errors.
options.zh: 接收初始化、文件与命令错误。

properties.name: ready
properties.en: Resolves after the initial drawing is mounted and fitted.
properties.zh: 初始图档完成挂载和适配后 resolve。

properties.name: element
properties.zh: 已挂载的编辑器根元素。

properties.name: document
properties.zh: ready 完成后的当前图档。

properties.name: sdk
properties.en: SDK used by the editor. Register plugins here; use editor.execute() or pass a document explicitly for commands when several editors share this SDK.
properties.zh: 编辑器使用的 SDK，可在此注册插件。多个编辑器共享时，使用 editor.execute() 或显式指定 document 来确定命令操作的图纸。

properties.name: workbench
properties.en: Advanced workbench access for custom tools and renderer integration.
properties.zh: 面向自定义工具与渲染集成的高级工作台入口。

properties.name: disposed
properties.en: Whether dispose() has released the editor.
properties.zh: dispose() 是否已释放编辑器。

methods.name: open
methods.en: Open DXF or KJD content. File names can supply format detection.
methods.zh: 打开 DXF 或 KJD 内容；可通过文件名自动识别格式。

methods.name: save
methods.en: Save KJD by default or DXF when selected. Set download:false to handle the result yourself.
methods.zh: 默认保存 KJD，也可选择 DXF；设 download:false 后自行处理结果。

methods.name: execute
methods.en: Run a command against the current drawing and receive its revisioned receipt.
methods.zh: 对当前图档执行命令并获得带修订信息的回执。

methods.name: undo
methods.en: Undo the most recent committed transaction.
methods.zh: 撤销最近一次已提交事务。

methods.name: redo
methods.en: Redo the next transaction in session history.
methods.zh: 重做当前会话历史中的下一项事务。

methods.name: fit
methods.en: Fit the active drawing to the current viewport.
methods.zh: 将活动图档适配到当前视口。

methods.name: setDocument
methods.en: Attach and activate an existing document.
methods.zh: 挂接并激活一个现有图档。

methods.name: setSelection
methods.en: Replace selection through the serialized command queue and return the accepted IDs.
methods.zh: 通过串行命令队列替换选择集，并返回已接受的 ID。

methods.name: getSelection
methods.en: Read the current selected object IDs.
methods.zh: 读取当前已选对象 ID。

methods.name: setTheme
methods.en: Switch panel and canvas appearance immediately.
methods.zh: 立即切换面板与画布外观。

methods.name: setTool
methods.en: Activate select, pan, drawing or measurement tools.
methods.zh: 激活选择、平移、绘制或测量工具。

methods.name: setTitle
methods.en: Update the title displayed above the drawing.
methods.zh: 更新图档上方显示的标题。

methods.name: setOptions
methods.en: Update editor chrome, editing mode and file-size limit without replacing the drawing or its undo history.
methods.zh: 原位更新编辑器界面、编辑模式与文件大小限制，不替换图档或撤销历史。

methods.name: on
methods.en: Subscribe to an editor event and receive an unsubscribe function.
methods.zh: 订阅编辑器事件，并获得取消订阅函数。

methods.name: dispose
methods.en: Unmount and release listeners and renderer resources. Safe to call twice.
methods.zh: 卸载并释放监听与渲染资源；可安全重复调用。

events.name: ready
events.en: Initial drawing and renderer are ready.
events.zh: 初始图档与渲染器已经就绪。

events.name: selectionchange
events.zh: 已选对象 ID 发生变化。

events.name: documentchange
events.en: Open or setDocument activated another drawing.
events.zh: open 或 setDocument 激活了另一张图档。

events.name: error
events.en: Initialization, file or queued command failed.
events.zh: 初始化、文件操作或队列命令失败。

events.name: dispose
events.en: The editor released its mounted resources.
events.zh: 编辑器已释放挂载资源。
